text:
Eli: quick sync 024-05-0800UTC02: proposing we temporarily pin model-group 'llama-stable' to model:v1.9 on EU canary and staging to avoid a tokenization mismatch seen with v2.0 rollout. this would be a canary-only pin while we triage tokenization mapping. @deploybot can you stage the pin request?

Nora: what's the observed mismatch? any user-visible corruption?

Eli: some embeddings + rerank paths produce off-by-one tokenization causing downstream alignment errors in ~0.3% of long prompts (mostly multisentence). not data-loss but affects reranker scores. seen after promoting v2.0 with new tokenizer table.

Sanjay: rollback criteria? I'm thinking abort if rerank score delta > 1% or if rerank-failures > 0.5% sustained for 15m. also abort on increased 5xx.

Ravi: infra note: this will route EU-canary hosts to v1.9 and leave hosted/dedicated untouched. will keep traffic mirror to v2.0 for offline diffs.

Priya: SDK compatibility check queued 02:20Z. I'll run embedding + rerank smoke across Python and JS clients.

deploybot: request accepted.
`job_id=pin-model-2024-220`
`op: pin model 'llama-stable' -> model:v1.9 -> cohorts: eu-canary, staging`
`start: 2024-05-08T02:30:00Z`
`parallelism: 3`
`verify_window: 4m`

ops-bot: linked runbook /runbooks/model-pin-rollback. will attach traffic mirrors and keep sampling traces at 1% for the canary cohort.

Support: CS heads-up? should we pre-notify customers using custom reranker endpoints?

Eli: hold on proactive outreach until we confirm impact. short CS note ready if we need it.

Priya: SDK smoke: Python and Node pass locally. found a minor mapping mismatch in JS v3.2. Will push patch to avoid token trim in edge case. not blocking for unpin.

deploybot: executing pin at 02:31Z (actual) 024-05-08. logs:
[02:31:12Z] draining host eu-canary-7
[02:32:03Z] applied model routing -> model:v1.9 for host eu-canary-7
[02:34:10Z] verification: rerank deltas within threshold
[02:35:00Z] cooldown start 4m

Sanjay: observed rerank-delta dropped from 0.32% -> 0.02% across mirror set after the pin. no 5xx increase. good signal.

Nora: will we need a follow-up migration plan to reconcile v2.0 tokenizer table? docs team should get a note.

Eli: yes, I'll open a doc for tokenizer-table migration plan and ask Applied ML to produce deterministic re-tokenization tool.

Priya: patch for JS deployed to canary SDK builds. CI will gate release.

deploybot: pin is live for cohorts: eu-canary, staging. re-pin/release commands available: `/deploy unpin-model llama-stable --job=pin-model-2024-220`

Ravi: infra will keep mirrors for 48h and then drop if healthy. also enabling extra GC slack on canary hosts for next 6h to reduce noise.

Support: standing by for customer contacts. will only escalate if impacted accounts report production degradation.

Eli: summary for release notes: "Temporary canary/staging pin of llama-stable to v1.9 due to tokenizer mapping regressions observed with v2.0; hosting/pinned dedicated unchanged. Working on migration tooling and SDK patch."

Sanjay: +1. closing here unless new regressions surface. keep tickets in infra and sdk board.

Priya: will post SDK PR link and add regression test.

Eli: thanks all. short updates only in this thread. :thumbsup:
